10 Best Honeymoon Hotels

heroSub: 10 Koh Samui hotels and resorts made for couples and honeymooners that we've reviewed in depth — from sea-view private-pool villas at Banyan Tree and W, to the quiet private bays of Garrya Tongsai Bay and Renaissance, garden beach villas at Santiburi, and romantic boutiques and design hotels that photograph beautifully. From about ฿3,500–18,000/night.
introH2: 💑 Why Koh Samui works for a honeymoon, and how to pick the right stay for you two
introHtml: Koh Samui is one of the islands Thai couples choose most for a honeymoon — it packs several styles of stay onto one island, you can fly straight in, and the Gulf of Thailand side is swimmable most of the year · But "honeymoon hotel" here comes in very different shapes, so matching it to you two matters more than you'd think · The first group is sea-view private-pool villas that sell full privacy: Banyan Tree, where every villa has its own infinity pool on the hillside above Lamai Bay, and W Koh Samui, with a private pool in all 74 villas on a headland · The second is private-bay resorts and garden villas that lean into quiet and nature: Garrya Tongsai Bay on a private 28-acre bay, Renaissance on a private cove at the north end of Lamai, and Santiburi, whose single-storey villas sit in a mature garden by Maenam Beach · The third is beachfront boutiques and design hotels for couples who value atmosphere and photos: The Library with its iconic red pool, Zazen, a zen boutique that's popular for weddings, Hansar on Bophut Beach within walking distance of Fisherman's Village, SALA Samui with black-and-white design pool villas on Chaweng, and Rocky's, a boutique on a private rocky cove and the easiest on the budget · Questions to ask before you book: do you want a private pool in the room, do you need real sand you can walk into or are you fine with a rocky cove / quiet beach that's more about the view, do you want total seclusion or to walk out to restaurants, and is anyone in your party less mobile (many stays are on hillsides and rely on buggies) · This guide gathers 10 Koh Samui honeymoon hotels we've reviewed in depth — all built from reading real guest reviews, with the good and the honest caveats spelled out, prices compared across 3 booking sites, and direct links to book
mrtHtml: Koh Samui has no rail transit — you'll get around by rental car, Grab, taxi, or hotel transfer, and there's a Samui Airport (USM) on the island with direct flights · The honeymoon stays in this guide are spread around the island, and choosing the right zone matters more than you'd think · North coast (Bophut–Choeng Mon–Maenam · closest to the airport, ~10–20 min · quiet) — Garrya Tongsai Bay, W Koh Samui, Santiburi, Hansar and Zazen sit here, with fast airport access and a restful mood · Chaweng (east coast · lively, walkable nightlife) — The Library and SALA Samui are right on Chaweng, giving you both the sea and the shops within walking distance · Lamai (south-east · a mix of quiet and buzz) — Banyan Tree on the hill above Lamai Bay, with Rocky's and Renaissance on private rocky/cove coves at the end of Lamai · One thing to know: many hillside and tiered-villa stays here (Banyan Tree, W, Garrya, Rocky's, Renaissance) have steep paths and stairs and rely on buggies — if anyone has trouble walking, ask for a villa near the central areas when you book · And the north-coast beaches (Bophut/Maenam) are quiet and shallow, better for lounging and photos than all-day deep swimming

entries.storyHtml: If the honeymoon in your head is waking up, stepping into your own pool and watching the bay at sunrise with nobody around, Banyan Tree Samui is the closest match in this set — a resort on a private hillside sloping down to Lamai Bay, with all 88 villas tiered to face the sea and a private infinity pool in every single one, no exceptions · Its 9.5 is the highest score in this guide; real guest reviews praise the privacy of a villa with its own pool, staff whose buggies usually arrive within 4–5 minutes, a small private beach with free kayaks and snorkel gear, and the Banyan Tree Spa with its Rainforest hydrotherapy zone · Honest caveats: the resort is on a steep hillside and relies on buggies throughout, some room interiors are showing their age, the private beach reveals rocks at low tide, and the resort is set apart from town so you'll drive out to Lamai/Chaweng · Best for honeymooners and anniversary couples with the budget who want a genuinely private sea-view pool villa and service that reads your mind
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget stretches, pick Ocean View or above — some lower villas have their view partly blocked by trees · Use the free buggy rather than forcing the climb · Try the Rainforest zone before a massage and book a table at Saffron at check-in · And flag that it's your honeymoon/anniversary when you book — the resort often has a little surprise ready

Score 9.5, highest in the set · warm, attentive service and quick buggies

entries.storyHtml: For couples who want to retreat into a quiet bay that feels like it's yours alone, Garrya Tongsai Bay is a rare answer — a resort on a private 28-acre bay in the Choeng Mon area, where the founder banned cutting the big trees back in 1987, so it feels like it's tucked into a seaside forest rather than a landscaped garden · What couples talk about most is the "bath with a view" concept: almost every room has a terrace bathtub facing the bay, and a soak at dusk is the prettiest light of the day · Real guest reviews reserve their strongest praise for the staff (Booking scores the staff category as high as 9.9), the clear-water private beach, and a breakfast many call one of the best on the island · Honest caveats: the resort spreads across a hillside so upper rooms mean a walk or a buggy wait, the location is set apart so you'll drive out, and after all these years the design is classic rather than sharply modern · Best for couples chasing quiet, real nature and warm name-remembering service, close to the airport
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a Seafront/Beachfront room near the beach if you want easy walking and a full sea view · Make the most of that terrace bath at dusk · Book Fish Tales beachside for its fresh seafood · And since it's only 10 minutes from the airport, it suits couples on a short trip or who want to land and be at the room fast
pros: A quiet private bay with the original nature intact — genuinely secluded
Almost every room has a sea-view terrace bath — hard to find elsewhere
Warm, name-remembering staff (9.9 staff score) · clear-water private beach
Widely praised breakfast · only ~10 minutes from Samui Airport
cons: Spread across a hillside — upper rooms mean a walk or a buggy wait
Set apart — you'll call a car to eat or explore outside
Open since 1987 · some furniture and woodwork show their age (per reviews)

entries.storyHtml: If your honeymoon style wants both a private villa with a pool and an evening scene with a bar over the sea, W Koh Samui puts both in one place — a resort on a green headland at the north of the island, with villas tiered so each is out of sight of the next, and a private pool in all 74 villas · The signature image is WOOBAR, whose infinity pool spills out until its edge blends into the sea, plus the W letters on the sand that couples photograph at sunset · Real guest reviews reserve their loudest praise for service (staff category 9.7), spacious clean rooms with soft beds, a made-to-order breakfast, and the AWAY Spa · Honest caveats: peak-season pricing pushes the value score to 8.5, the lowest of every category; the resort is on a hillside that relies on buggies; the headland is set apart so you'll drive out; and the north-facing beach has little surf and gets shallow at low tide — better for lounging than all-day deep swimming · Best for honeymooners who love photos and want a design-forward pool villa with a beach bar — book low season and the overall value gets much stronger
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Book low season (May–Oct) for clearly lower rates and the greenest jungle around the villas · Jungle Oasis is the best value and most private, with the same private pool for less · Get to WOOBAR before sunset to grab a poolside seat · Flag your honeymoon at booking, and reserve AWAY Spa and a beach dinner ahead

entries.storyHtml: For couples who want a quiet, romantic mood at a price gentler than the top-brand resorts, Rocky's Boutique Resort is a name reviews return to — a boutique resort on a private rocky cove at the south end of Lamai Beach, wrapped in natural boulders that give it privacy and a distinctive view, yet still a short walk from the Lamai strip · The heart of it is two free-form pools looking out to sea, The Dining Room by the water, and service that real guest reviews single out as a highlight — staff who remember your name and help arrange trips · There's a Beachfront with Plunge Pool room with a private plunge pool by the sea for couples who want extra privacy · Honest caveats: the beach out front is a rocky cove, not fine sand, so it's not for swimming (there's a free shuttle twice a day to sandy beaches); the resort steps down a slope with stairs; and some room décor is starting to show its age · Best for couples and honeymooners who value atmosphere and service over having a long sandy beach at the door
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget stretches, pick Premier Ocean View or above, or the Beachfront with Plunge Pool for a full cove view and a private plunge pool · Check the free shuttle times to Lamai/Chaweng on day one if you plan on sand · Budget for a Grab or a scooter if you'll come and go a lot · And compare the direct-booking perks (airport transfers / free massage on some stays) against the platform prices
pros: A quiet, romantic private rocky cove — yet still walkable to the Lamai strip

entries.storyHtml: If your two want a grown-up kind of quiet with plenty of room to breathe, Santiburi Koh Samui is a name honeymoon reviews mention often — one of the island's pioneering luxury resorts that spreads 96 single-storey villas and suites across a mature 23-acre tropical garden, so walking around feels more like a private village than a hotel · It sits on Maenam Beach on the north coast, one of Samui's quietest and widest, with a gently shallow shore, a ~300m private beach, and a pool the resort proudly calls one of the island's largest · Real guest reviews praise the spacious, spotless villas (9.4 cleanliness), staff who remember your name (9.4 service), and a consistently praised breakfast · Honest caveats: food, drinks and spa inside the resort run expensive; some villas show their age and the design leans classic; a few in-room details are thin for the price (limited bedside outlets, no clock); and it's about 30 minutes from Chaweng's nightlife · Best for honeymooners who value quiet, privacy and service over brand-new design
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Deluxe Garden Villa is roomy and calm at the lowest rate; add a plunge pool, or step up to Beachfront for a special occasion · Flag your honeymoon/anniversary at booking for a little surprise · Eat out at Maenam village or Fisherman's Village to manage the budget · And golfers should book a round at Santiburi Samui Country Club ahead
pros: Single-storey villas in a 23-acre garden — spacious and private, like a village
A quiet, wide private Maenam beach with a gentle shallow shore · a large pool

entries.storyHtml: For couples who want a sharp-looking pool villa on Chaweng that's still quiet enough to sleep, SALA Samui Chaweng Beach pulls it off in the island's busiest zone — a SALA-group resort hidden behind white walls, so once you step in you almost forget you're on Chaweng · The Oceanfront Wing on the beach has 52 rooms and suites, most with a private pool, a few steps from the sand and the wing couples chase; the Garden Wing is gentler on the wallet, across a small road · The signature is the minimalist black-and-white design that photographs beautifully, a pool that runs straight out to Chaweng, and the moon-inspired SALA Spa · Real guest reviews praise the spacious rooms, warm staff, a made-to-order breakfast, and being only 15 minutes from the airport · Honest caveats: food and room-service prices run high, the Garden Wing means crossing a road to the beach, and the villa pools aren't heated so they feel cold in the evening · Best for couples who want a design pool villa on the beach in a walkable zone
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the sea view is the point, pick the Oceanfront Wing with a private pool from the start — it's a few steps to the sand · Use the airport being only ~15 minutes away for arrival or departure day · Have breakfast at The Tent right when it opens before the sun gets strong · And book the SALA Spa ahead, since evening slots fill fast
pros: Sharp minimalist black-and-white design — photogenic from every angle
Oceanfront Wing on the beach, most with a private pool, steps from the sand

On Chaweng yet still quiet · only ~15 min from the airport

entries.storyHtml: For couples who want a quiet beachfront resort where you can still walk to dinner in town without calling a car, Hansar Samui fits best — a right-sized resort on Bophut Beach where a few steps out the gate takes you into Fisherman's Village, a row of old wooden shophouses turned into restaurants, bars and cafés · It has 74 rooms and every one has a sea view; even the entry room is a generous ~50 sqm with a private balcony you'll actually use for morning coffee · What reviews agree on most is the service, which many call the reason they'd return, plus a saltwater infinity pool by the sea and the Luxsa Spa that guests call the best hour of the trip · Honest caveats: Bophut is a quiet beach with the water pulling far out at low tide and some natural seaweed on days — not a wide white-sand beach; the resort has been open years so some rooms show their age and a few have semi-open bathrooms; and peak-season pricing runs high · Best for couples and honeymooners who want a calm beachfront resort you can still walk out from, with excellent service
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Book low season (May–Oct) when entry rates drop into the low ฿10,000s or below on some deals · Every room has a sea view, but ask for a higher floor / Sea View XL for a more open outlook · Walk into Fisherman's Village in ~2 minutes — no car needed · And reserve the Luxsa Spa and a beachside dinner at H Bistro ahead, flagging any special occasion
pros: Service and staff are the standout — warm, attentive, name-remembering
Beachfront on Bophut, a 2-min walk to Fisherman's Village · ~10 min from airport

entries.addr: 14/1 Moo 2, Chaweng Beach, Bo Phut, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: For photo-loving couples and design lovers who want to bring home a full memory card, The Library is a hotel even people who've never been to Samui have seen — the whole property is designed around the idea of a "book," in all-white minimalism, and it's a Design Hotels member · But what made it famous is the bright red swimming pool, tiled in red mosaic so that from above or at sunset it glows against the white deck and blue sea like nowhere else (the water is clear — the red is all tile, and it swims normally) · Real guest reviews praise the mid-Chaweng beachfront location (a 9.5 location score, the highest of every category), walkable restaurants and bars, and spacious rooms with an iMac and a real library · Honest caveats: it's design-led over function, some all-white surfaces show their age, the room lighting is deliberately dim, in-hotel food and rates run high (value 8.5), and the Chaweng beach out front is a busy public beach with hawkers · Best for couples and honeymooners who love photos and see a stay as an experience of atmosphere
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Shoot the red pool at early morning when it's quiet or at sunset when the color is strongest — the high angle from the upper walkway is best · For a private pool, choose the Secret Pool Villa · Eat some meals out on the Chaweng strip to manage the budget · And ask for a renovated room or villa if room condition matters to you
pros: The red pool and all-white design are one of a kind — photogenic everywhere
On Chaweng mid-beach, walkable to restaurants and bars (9.5 location)
Spacious, clean, comfortable rooms with an iMac and a real library
The Page by the sea is a lovely spot for sunset cocktails
cons: Value is the lowest score (8.5) — in-hotel food and rates run high
Some all-white surfaces show their age · room lighting is deliberately dim
The Chaweng beach out front is a busy public beach with hawkers (per reviews)

entries.storyHtml: For couples who want a small, quiet, romantic stay by the sea without paying pool-villa prices, Zazen Boutique Resort & Spa is a name honeymoon and wedding reviews return to — a 26-unit boutique in a garden on the quiet north stretch of Bophut Beach, designed in a zen Thai-Japanese style with wood and natural materials, so many reviews say they felt themselves "slow down" the moment they walked in · Another heart of it is The Club by Zazen, a seaside restaurant islanders visit even without staying, with tables on the sand under candlelight — and every Sunday there's a Thai Night with custom dance performances and live music, an evening couples remember · Real guest reviews praise the spacious, clean rooms (9.3), warm staff great for special occasions (9.3), and a reasonably priced garden spa · Honest caveats: the beach out front is narrow and shallow, awkward to swim from at low tide; room and food prices run a bit high (value 8.5); rooms near the restaurant may hear music on weekend evenings; and it's a pioneering boutique that shows its age · Best for couples and honeymooners who want a small, quiet, romantic boutique with great dinners in one place
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For the most space and privacy, pick the Garden Villa deep in the garden · Come on a Sunday evening for Thai Night, and book a seaside table and the spa ahead · If you're sensitive to noise, ask for an inner-garden room at booking · And compare low-season rates (May–Oct), which usually drop clearly from year-end peak

entries.storyHtml: For couples who want the quiet of a private bay with a big-chain standard at a price gentler than the very top brands, Renaissance Koh Samui is backed by the biggest review base in this set (2,151 reviews) — a Marriott Bonvoy resort on two small private coves at the north end of Lamai Beach, wrapped in rocky headlands and green forest for a privacy that central-strip resorts can't offer · Even the entry room comes with an outdoor jacuzzi that many reviews love, stepping up to pool villas with a private pool and a walled garden · The heart of it is the sea-view infinity pool where guests spend the most time, the Tawann restaurant over the bay, and the Quan Spa that guests call a highlight · Honest caveats: the beach out front has rocks and coral in the sand and is shallow at low tide, so it's not for swimming (there's a free shuttle to sandy beaches); the resort steps down a slope with stairs; and some room décor is starting to show its age · Best for couples and honeymooners — especially Marriott Bonvoy members — who value atmosphere, service and a sea-view pool over sand at the door
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget stretches, pick Deluxe Sea View or above, or a pool villa, for a bay view and a private pool · Bonvoy members should compare booking direct for upgrade / breakfast / points against the platform prices · Check the shuttle times to Lamai/Chaweng on day one if you want sand · And book the Quan Spa and a Tawann dinner ahead at peak
pros: A quiet private cove with high privacy — yet still a shuttle into the Lamai strip
Biggest review base in the set (2,151) · warm, name-remembering staff
A pretty sea-view infinity pool · entry rooms come with an outdoor jacuzzi
Pool villas with private pools · Marriott Bonvoy standard and points · praised Quan Spa
cons: The beach out front has rocks and coral and is shallow at low tide — not for swimming
The resort steps down a slope with plenty of stairs and ramps
Set outside the strip · in-resort food and drinks run expensive (per reviews)

adviceTitle: How to pick the right Koh Samui honeymoon hotel for you two

advice.head: Celebrating a wedding, budget's there, want a sea-view private-pool villa
advice.bodyHtml: → Banyan Tree Samui ฿18,000, a private infinity pool in every villa, 9.5, the highest score in the set · or W Koh Samui ฿14,000, all 74 pool villas on a headland with WOOBAR by the sea

advice.head: You want a quiet private bay and real nature
advice.bodyHtml: → Garrya Tongsai Bay ฿9,500, a private 28-acre bay with a sea-view bath in almost every room, ~10 min from the airport · or Renaissance Koh Samui ฿6,500, a private cove at the north end of Lamai + Quan Spa

advice.head: You want a pool villa / villa on real sand you can walk into
advice.bodyHtml: → SALA Samui Chaweng ฿7,500, design pool villas on Chaweng, steps to the sand · or Santiburi ฿10,000, garden villas on a quiet, wide private Maenam beach

advice.head: You love design and beautiful photos
advice.bodyHtml: → The Library ฿8,500, the iconic red pool and all-white design on Chaweng · or Zazen ฿5,500, a zen beach boutique popular for honeymoons and weddings

advice.head: You want a beachfront resort you can still walk out from
advice.bodyHtml: → Hansar Samui ฿8,000, every room a sea view on Bophut Beach, a 2-min walk to Fisherman's Village, with service guests call the reason they'd return

advice.head: Easier on the budget but still romantic
advice.bodyHtml: → Rocky's Boutique Resort ฿3,500, a boutique on a private rocky cove at the end of Lamai with service guests call a highlight · or Zazen ฿5,500, a zen beach boutique with a seaside dinner

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms outside peak season and can change by date and season — always check live prices and compare 3 sites before booking · The scores and highlights here come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms, not from a personal stay · Koh Samui's high season (December–February, plus the sunny mid-year stretch) pushes prices up clearly, and the limited pool villas and beachfront villas tend to sell out first, so plan 1–2 months ahead · Many hillside and tiered-villa stays here have steep paths and stairs and rely on buggies — if anyone is less mobile, ask for a villa near the central areas when you book · The north-coast beaches (Bophut/Maenam) and some rocky coves are quiet and shallow, better for lounging and photos than all-day deep swimming; many resorts offer a sea-view pool or a shuttle to sandy beaches · Koh Samui has no rail transit — get around by rental car, Grab, or hotel transfer · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — what couples ask most about Koh Samui honeymoon hotels

faq.q: ❓ What's the best honeymoon hotel in Koh Samui?
faq.a: It depends on your style and budget · If you're going by score and a sea-view private-pool villa, Banyan Tree Samui 9.5, with a private infinity pool in every villa, is number one in this set · Want a quiet private bay, choose Garrya Tongsai Bay 9.4 · Want a design-forward pool villa with a beach bar, choose W Koh Samui 9.3 · Easier on the budget but still romantic, choose Rocky's 9.2 (฿3,500) · And the biggest, most-proven review base is Renaissance 8.9 (2,151 reviews)

faq.q: ❓ Which Koh Samui private-pool villas are best for couples?
faq.a: If you want a private pool in truly every villa, Banyan Tree Samui (88 villas · a private infinity pool in each) and W Koh Samui (74 villas · a private pool in each) are the clearest · SALA Samui Chaweng's Oceanfront Wing is mostly private-pool and on the beach · Santiburi and Renaissance offer both plunge-pool rooms and full pool villas · Most sit on hillsides or tiers with steep paths that rely on buggies — ask for a villa near the central areas if anyone is less mobile

faq.q: ❓ Which zone should we stay in for a Koh Samui honeymoon?
faq.a: The north coast (Bophut–Choeng Mon–Maenam) is quietest and closest to the airport (~10–20 min), best for resting — Garrya Tongsai Bay, W, Santiburi, Hansar and Zazen are here · Chaweng is lively with walkable nightlife — The Library and SALA Samui are on it · Lamai mixes quiet and buzz — Banyan Tree, Rocky's and Renaissance sit here · Choose based on whether you two want seclusion or to walk out to restaurants

faq.q: ❓ Which Koh Samui honeymoon stays are on real sand you can swim from?
faq.a: The ones that open onto sand you can walk into here are SALA Samui Chaweng and The Library (on Chaweng), Santiburi and Hansar (Maenam/Bophut, quiet and shallow) and Zazen (on Bophut) · Banyan Tree has a small private beach in its bay, while Rocky's and Renaissance sit on rocky coves that are lovely to look at but not for swimming (they have sea-view pools and shuttles to sandy beaches)

faq.q: ❓ How much do Koh Samui honeymoon hotels cost?
faq.a: In this guide, prices start at about ฿3,500–18,000 per night · The easiest on the wallet are Rocky's from ฿3,500, Zazen ฿5,500, Renaissance ฿6,500 and SALA Samui ฿7,500 · Mid-range is Hansar ฿8,000, The Library ฿8,500, Garrya Tongsai Bay ฿9,500 and Santiburi ฿10,000 · The luxe pool villas are W Koh Samui from ฿14,000 and Banyan Tree from ฿18,000 · All are approximate starting rates outside peak season, which climbs clearly in high season

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should we book, and how do we get around?
faq.a: In Samui's high season (December–February and the sunny mid-year stretch), book 1–2 months ahead, especially the limited pool villas and beachfront villas like Banyan Tree, W and Santiburi that sell out first · In low season, 2–3 weeks is fine and prices drop a lot · Getting there: Koh Samui has its own airport (USM) with direct flights, no rail transit — get around by rental car, Grab, taxi, or hotel transfer · Flag your special occasion (honeymoon/anniversary) at booking, as many resorts arrange a surprise · Every platform offers Free Cancellation, so lock a rate like that if plans aren't firm, then compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price
